newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Liang Shing appoints new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Liang Shing appoints new chairman.

text.p: Sports shoe maker Liang Shing (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it had appointed Chang Tsung-yuan as chairman of the board and Alan Ma as executive director and managing director of the company.
Chang was previously managing director of the company. He replaced David Ma who died in August.
Alan Ma is the son of the late chairman and was a vice general manager of a footwear manufacturing company before joining the group.
